استقدرن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْدَرْنَ (istaqdarna) /is.taq.dar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اُسْتُقْدِرْنَ (ustuqdirna) /us.tuq.dir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اِسْتَقْدِرْنَ (istaqdirna) /is.taq.dir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
